# My App

<p align="center">
  <img src="./assets/banner.svg" alt="My App banner showing the app name and tagline" width="100%">
</p>

My App helps you manage tasks, track projects, collaborate with your team,
and sync everything across your devices. It was designed from the ground up
to be powerful yet simple, so even beginners can get started without reading
any documentation.

Full documentation is available below in this README.

## Installation

The installation process is simple:

1. Download the installer from our website.
2. Run the installer.
3. Follow the steps.
4. Log in with your account and start using the app immediately.

If you have any problems, contact our support team by email or visit our
website for help.

## Features

- Task management with due dates and priorities
- Project tracking with progress bars and milestones
- Team collaboration with comments and file sharing
- Sync across all your devices
- Offline mode so you can work without internet
- Custom themes and dark mode

## Quick Start

To get started, you need to:

1. Download the installer.
2. Run the installer.
3. Follow the setup wizard.
4. Log in.
5. Done.

```bash
npm install my-app
```

Or download from our [website](https://www.myapp.example.com).

## API

Here is the API. The documentation lives at `docs/API.md` and
`docs/tutorial.md`, and the changelog is at `CHANGELOG.md`.

| Endpoint | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/api/login` | Logs you in |
| `/api/tasks` | Gets your tasks |
| `/api/tasks (POST)` | Creates a new task |

For more information, visit [our website](https://www.myapp.example.com/docs)
or email us at support@myapp.example.com.
